Buying · A guide to your next move

Before you fall in love with a home.

A practical checklist for a more thoughtful first viewing.

01

Start with the everyday

Before your viewing, write down three things your next home needs to do well. Think about where you work, what you store and how you spend an ordinary evening.

02

Look at the layout

Notice how rooms connect. Imagine where your furniture would go and how people would move through the space. A photograph can make a room feel different from the experience of standing in it.

03

Keep a practical record

Make notes about light, storage and visible condition. Write down anything you want to ask about, rather than relying on your memory after several viewings.

04

Ask before assuming

Ask your appointed agent which property details have been verified. A viewing is not a substitute for professional inspections, document review or your own due diligence.

05

Give yourself a comparison

Afterwards, compare the home with your original priorities. What fits well? What would you need to change? What remains uncertain?

General editorial guidance prepared for this design concept. This is not legal, financial or property-specific advice.
